name: github-runner-pool
description: GitHub Actions runners in one virtual machine (Debian 13; 16 CPUs, 32GiB, 200GiB). A slot runs one job on a fresh just-in-time runner (actions/runner 2.338.2 by digest, with aptPackages added) with its own Docker daemon (docker 29.9.3-dind by digest), then replaces it. Settings: url (your organisation), runnerGroupId (a dedicated group). Created stopped: set GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, or GITHUB_TOKEN, then instance_start. Or registration-token mode: no credential.

settingRules.why: every class is kept one place under the cap: set maxSlots to the number of classes or more, or name fewer classes
